emily: Quick note from the runtime team: we need a compact compatibility envelope on compiled policy artifacts so runtimes can safely attach probe hints across canaries and rollouts.

raj: Agreed. We also need a tiny "proof" that runtime suggestions can attach so the compiler/service can validate them later.

alex: What should the compat envelope contain? My proposal: artifact_version, shape_id, shape_hash, capabilities, fallback_policy, builder_id. Keep it minimal.

sam: Also add a short ttl policy for runtime-probe keys. Runtimes will scrub keys older than TTL or when shape_id changes.

emily: Two concrete additions: (1) monotonic shape_id (int) for quick checks; (2) shape_hash (fingerprint) for stronger detection.

raj: For proofs I propose: 64-bit fingerprint (xxhash64) over (shape_hash || node_path || decision_delta || epoch) and a small namespace tag. Runtimes attach: namespace:probe-<runtime-id>, proof:0x..., ttl:secs.

alex: Example artifact header we can emit from compiler (sketch):
```json
{"artifact_v":"1","shape_id":"142","shape_hash":"a3b1f9c4","capabilities":["late_bind_probes","gc_namespacing"],"fallback_policy":"default-safe","builder":"policy-compiler-2.4"}
```

sam: Important reconciliation rules: if runtime sees shape_id != current_shape_id then it should only accept proofs when capability "accept-cross-shape-v1" is set. Otherwise proofs are ignored and keys are purged.

emily: GC semantics: runtime stores namespaced keys keyed by (artifact_v, shape_id, namespace). On load, scrub any namespace with shape_id < current_shape_id - 1 unless capability says otherwise.

raj: Failure modes:
- proof mapping fails -> runtime must route to fallback and emit a warning metric.
- proof collision (very rare) -> still safe: fallback check ensures no unsafe route chosen.

alex: Tradeoffs: proofs add bytes and compute. 8 bytes per proof is small; use xxhash64 in C binding to keep CPU low. Probabilistic collision acceptable with conservative fallback.

sam: Ops task: add compiler CI lint that flags node-id reuse across 3 consecutive shape_ids. Also add artifact upload check that shape_id increments monotonically.

emily: Security note: proofs should not encode secrets. Keep them deterministic hashes only.

devops-bot: build:policy-compiler 2.4 uploaded -> staging (canary 5%) :white_check_mark: <https://ci/redwood/7654321>

alex: Action items: emily write RFC describing envelope + GC; raj spec proof construction and example code; sam implement runtime namespacing + scrub; alex add compiler lint and rollout checklist. I'll schedule a short arch-checkin next week to sign off.

emily: Will draft RFC and include a couple of sample existing policies (latency-prioritized, cost-prioritized) to test proofs. Filing RFC WIP to docs/rfcs and ping arch-review when ready.
